notes: Authored in this repository as the standalone reviews package. There is no upstream pin and no custody table.
The four skills name review_command.py, security_scan.py, lifecycle_review.py, and review_setup.py. Those four scripts answer --help.
SAGA_LANGFUSE_ is the prefix of the bundled trace client's environment names. GH_, GITHUB_, and TYPESAFE_ are stripped the same way as other review tooling that can post or call a model.
prepare and finish write a packet directory. survey and write write the machine record under the reviews config directory.
